# Vendored data attribution

## boston_map.inc

Building footprints and heights, water, coastline and parks for central Boston,
generated by `tools/boston_map.py` from OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API. The
data was projected to millimetres, cleaned and simplified. The printed lid is a
Produced Work.
